test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains 135 m and 155 m in length, respectively, are running in opposite directions, one at the rate of 80 km/h and the other at the rate of 65 km/h. In how much time will they be completely clear of each other from the moment they meet?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two objects move in **opposite directions**, their **Relative Speed** is the sum of their individual speeds.

Total Distance to cover = Sum of **lengths of both trains** = 135 + 155 = 290 m.

Relative Speed = 80 + 65 = 145 km/h = 145 × (5/18) m/s.

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed = 290 ÷ (145 × 5/18) = (290 × 18) ÷ (145 × 5) = 2 × 18 ÷ 5 = 36 ÷ 5 = 7.2 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.2 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Length₁ = 135 m, Length₂ = 155 m, Speed₁ = 80 km/h, Speed₂ = 65 km/h.

**Formula Used:** Time = (Total Distance) ÷ (Relative Speed)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b68d36c4f57308cd95f3e0f834db706eeaaecf6b35bd6ad169b591ef246de858.png] 

⇒ Total Length = 135 + 155 = 290 m

⇒ Relative Speed = (80 + 65) × (5/18) m/s

⇒ Relative Speed = 145 × 5 ÷ 18 = 725 ÷ 18 m/s

⇒ Time taken = 290 ÷ (725 ÷ 18)

⇒ Time taken = (290 × 18) ÷ 725

⇒ Time taken = 5220 ÷ 725 = 7.2 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 7.2 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concepts

Same Direction: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ − S₂ | Opposite Direction: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ + S₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Train Crossing Objects

When crossing another train, distance = sum of lengths. When crossing a pole/man, distance = length of the train.</p
